reasons.plausibility: Controlling interstitial impurities in Ti–Ni-based alloys is well-established as a strategy to improve high-temperature mechanical properties, so the premise is scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: The proposed comparison of ultra-high-purity versus standard processing, with measured impurity levels and mechanical data, provides a direct and decisive test.
reasons.usefulness: Minimizing interstitials is a practical and relevant intervention in high-temperature alloy design, offering a clear path to potentially improved performance.
